title: Push Button
text: Change parameter or variable value using button, {Label} sets Block label position; {Connection} sets the block parameter value to connect parameter value connection, {Button Text} sets the text label, {On Value} sets the value assigned to connected parameter when button is pressed, {Button Type} sets the button response, {Opacity} sets the block background opacity, {Foreground Color} sets the block foreground color, {Background Color} sets the block background color, {Icon}, {Icon Alignment} sets the icon alignment relative to button text, {Customize Icon Color} sets the whether to use icon on and off colors, {On Color} sets the icon color when block is pressed or latched and {Off Color} sets the icon color when block is not pressed or latched. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Connection
params.values: Block parameter value to connect parameter value connection options

params.name: Button Text
params.values: Text label for button Button (default) | string | character vector

params.name: On Value
params.values: Value assigned to connected parameter when button is pressed or latched 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Button Type
params.values: Button response to click Momentary (default) | Latch

params.name: Label
params.values: Block label position Hide (default) | Bottom | Top

params.name: Foreground Color
params.values: Block foreground color [r g b] vector

params.name: Background Color
params.values: Block background color [r g b] vector

params.name: Icon
params.values: Icon to display on button SVG file | PNG file | JPEG file

params.name: Icon Alignment
params.values: Icon alignment relative to button text Left (default) | Right | Top | Bottom | Center

params.name: Customize Icon Color
params.values: Whether to use icon on and off colors Off (default) | On

params.name: On Color
params.values: Icon color when block is pressed or latched [r g b] vector

params.name: Off Color
params.values: Icon color when block is not pressed or latched [r g b] vector
